propositions: docs/README.md conflates audience routing, document summaries, taxonomy policy, and generated-artifact ownership in a single file that must be separated and reorganized

The documentation landing page must provide distinct navigation routes for clients, contributors, architecture readers, ADR readers, operators, research readers, and evidence readers while preserving discovery paths for CLI, MCP, adoption, contribution, and internals use

A single compact directory must link all 67 maintained top-level Markdown pages exactly once, classifying each under one audience route and removing outdated claims about six-relation ticket links and shared ADR numbers

The three existing troubleshooting rows with their remedies, and the three historical evidence pages (bash-migration.md, 88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md, dco-rollout-evidence.md) must be retained at their current paths and appear exactly once in the reorganized directory
